title: Ep 41 — Claude Now Runs a Quarter of Anthropic's Own R and D, and the Reddit Research Tool That Reddit Itself Killed
description: Anthropic discloses that Claude now leads twenty-six per cent of its own research and development, up from under one per cent in February, and proposes three new industry metrics for tracking AI self-improvement, while Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Google's Antigravity agent all ship incremental updates. Plus a deep dive on GummySearch, founder Fed's Reddit pain-point research tool that made real evidence-backed six-figure revenue before Reddit's own tightened API rules shut it down, and updates for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships including five days left on the DCMS good-causes consultation and a twenty-fourth straight quiet episode for sports-venue EV charging.
